priority_groups.description: Priority 1: Core configuration and Harness flow

tests.name: Load_WithValidAdjacentConfig_ReturnsImmutableSnapshot
tests.description: Load required activity fields and recursively freeze Harness settings once at startup.
tests.arrange: A valid adjacent JSON config with nested mappings and arrays
tests.act: Construct and load SkillActivityConfig, then modify the source file
tests.assert: Required values and the original deeply immutable Harness snapshot remain

tests.name: Run_WithNamespacedDevinConfig_BuildsSafeCommand
tests.description: DevinHarness translates explicit settings and defaults with an argv list.
tests.arrange: A controlled runner and devin model/permission mapping
tests.assert: Exactly one non-shell command contains the configured flags and prompt

tests.name: Execute_WithSuccessfulSentinel_CompletesFixedLifecycle
tests.description: The template invokes each hook in order, enters context, calls Harness once, and resolves the sentinel.
tests.arrange: A recording SkillActivity and Harness that writes a valid sentinel
tests.assert: Lifecycle order, context cleanup, immutable config, and output are correct

tests.name: Adapters_WithConcreteActivities_PreserveWireAndGradeSemantics
tests.description: Four concrete classes/configs retain naming, adapters, and grade enrichment.
tests.arrange: Concrete Activities with a fake Harness and grade artifact
tests.assert: Wire shapes, fallback names, score/passed, and accept-edits configs remain compatible

tests.name: Load_WithMissingUnreadableMalformedOrIncompleteConfig_FailsSanitized
tests.description: Invalid adjacent configuration prevents startup without leaking OS details.
tests.arrange: Missing, unreadable, malformed, wrong-typed, and incomplete files
tests.assert: Stable categorized errors name only safe paths/fields and Harness is not invoked

tests.name: Run_WithUnknownOrInvalidDevinSetting_RejectsBeforeLaunch
tests.arrange: Unknown keys, wrong namespace types, null/empty/wrong values
tests.assert: A sanitized ValueError occurs and runner is not called

tests.name: Execute_WithInvalidHarnessOrHookResult_FailsClearly
tests.description: Template boundary validation rejects wrong Harness and six hook result types.

tests.name: Execute_WithNonzeroHarnessResult_FailsWithoutSensitiveOutput
tests.description: Nonzero execution fails once and logs only sanitized metadata.
tests.assert: SkillActivityError and safe event occur without stderr/prompt/config

tests.name: Run_WithLaunchOSError_ReportsSanitizedFailure
tests.arrange: Runner raises OSError with sensitive detail
tests.assert: devin_launch_failed is raised/logged without raw detail

priority_groups.description: Priority 3: Sentinel, isolation, and compatibility edges

tests.name: Execute_WithStaleSentinel_RemovesBeforeHarness
tests.description: Retries cannot consume stale completion state.
tests.arrange: A stale sentinel and recording Harness
tests.assert: Sentinel is absent when Harness starts and fresh output wins

tests.name: Execute_WithMissingSentinel_UsesConcreteFallbackAndWarns
tests.description: Consumed sentinels use the concrete output convention.
tests.assert: Expected output path is returned with a sanitized warning

tests.name: Execute_WithMalformedMismatchedOrIncompleteSentinel_Fails
tests.description: Present invalid sentinels retain strict ADR-004 semantics.
tests.arrange: Malformed JSON, wrong task, or missing verify key

tests.name: Execute_WithRequiredInputMissing_FailsAtFallback
tests.description: Concrete output conventions clearly reject absent input paths.
tests.arrange: No input paths and no sentinel

tests.name: Run_WithSiblingHarnessNamespace_IgnoresSibling
tests.arrange: Valid devin and arbitrary sibling namespace
tests.assert: Only devin is inspected and sibling data is unchanged

tests.name: Execute_Concurrently_SharesImmutableSnapshotWithoutMutation
tests.description: Worker-lifetime configuration is safe across invocations.
tests.arrange: One Activity instance used by concurrent calls
tests.act: Execute calls that attempt nested mutation
tests.assert: Both calls observe the same unchanged immutable snapshot

tests.name: Import_WithInvalidConcreteConfig_PreventsWorkerStartup
tests.description: Eager concrete instance construction validates before polling.
tests.arrange: A concrete module whose adjacent config is invalid
tests.assert: Import fails before a Worker starts

tests.name: Onboard_WithNewClassAndAdjacentConfig_RequiresNoCentralCatalogEdit
tests.description: A probe Activity demonstrates the two-file extension contract.
tests.arrange: A new subclass and adjacent config with alternate Harness namespace
tests.assert: It succeeds without generic runner or Devin profile-map changes
